verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs say it has built-in support for multiple social providers (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more). Its SSO plugin adds OIDC, generic OAuth2 and SAML 2.0 providers, and its auth setup lives in a code-based config object. A community user independently reports using the built-in Google, Apple and GitHub OAuth providers, and another describes getting many sign-in options from included defaults without special code. Missing for 10: an enumerated list showing how broad the provider catalog actually is, and a concrete socialProviders configuration example showing providers are enabled purely by config.
